description: Uncut 26 s gameplay recording in SuperTux's own forest level (world2/walking_leaves.stl) with a few extra objects, a column of coins and a walking leaf placed near the start: Tux picks up and handles objects on a tree branch and on the forest floor.
reproduces: https://github.com/SuperTux/supertux/issues/1398 (plus further defects injected for this task)
scenario: World 2 forest level 'walking_leaves.stl', re-recorded headlessly from this task's own build: Tux on a tree branch and on the forest floor below it, picking up and handling objects placed there; a column of coins hangs under the branch's end and a walking leaf patrols a ledge below the branch.
